PrivacyPolicyPage.intro3: Bw'okozesa InstaView Stories, okkiriza empisa ezinnyonnyoddwa mu Tteeka lino ery'Eby'Ekyama.
PrivacyPolicyPage.collectText1: InstaView Stories ekoleddwa okusobozesa abakozesa okunoonyereza ebiri ku Instagram ez'olujjudde ebiriwo awatali kwetaagisa akaunti wadde login ya Instagram.
PrivacyPolicyPage.collectText2: Okusinziira ku ngeri gy'okozesaamu omukutu gwaffe, tuyinza okufuna amawulire amatono aga tekiniki nga:
PrivacyPolicyPage.collectText3: Tetukusaba kuwaayo password yo eya Instagram wadde ebikwata ku login yo eya Instagram.
PrivacyPolicyPage.providedText1: Bw'otukwatagana ku email, tuyinza okufuna amawulire g'olonda okuteeka mu bubaka bwo, gamba ng'endagiriro yo eya email, erinnya lyo, oba ebikwata ebirala by'owaayo ku bwo wennyini.
PrivacyPolicyPage.providedText2: Tolina kutuma password, amawulire g'ensimbi, wadde amawulire amalala ag'obwannamunigina ag'ekyama okuyita mu makubo gaffe ag'okutukwatagana.
PrivacyPolicyPage.publicContentText1: InstaView Stories ekoleddwa okufuna n'okulaga ebiri ku Instagram ez'olujjudde ebiriwo.
PrivacyPolicyPage.publicContentText2: Kino kiyinza okuzingiramu ebiri eby'olujjudde ebiriwo nga:
PrivacyPolicyPage.publicContentText3: Tetusaba bwannannyini ku biri bya Instagram eby'ab'ekyokusatu. Ebiri bisigala nga bigobererwa eddembe, ebiragiro, n'empisa za bannannyini baabyo n'emikutu gyabwe.
PrivacyPolicyPage.useIntro: Amawulire agakuŋŋaanyizibwa okuyita ku mukutu gayinza okukozesebwa:
PrivacyPolicyPage.useItem3: Okutegeera engeri abakozesa gye beetaba nayo omukutu gwaffe
PrivacyPolicyPage.useItem4: Okuzuula obuzibu bwa tekiniki n'okukozesa obubi
PrivacyPolicyPage.cookiesText1: InstaView Stories eyinza okukozesa cookies wadde obukodyo obufaanagana okuwagira ebikozesebwa by'omukutu, okutegeera engeri omukutu gye gukozesebwamu, okulongoosa enkola, oba okuwa obuweereza obukwatagana.
PrivacyPolicyPage.cookiesText2: Osobola okufuga oba okuziyiza cookies okuyita mu ntegeka za burawuza yo. Okuziyiza cookies ezimu kiyinza okukosa ebimu ku bikozesebwa by'omukutu.
PrivacyPolicyPage.thirdPartyText1: Omukutu gwaffe guyinza okukozesa obuweereza bw'ab'ekyokusatu nga obw'okwekenneenya, okusuza omukutu (hosting), okulangirira, obukuumi, wadde abawa obuyambi abalala aba tekiniki.
PrivacyPolicyPage.thirdPartyText2: Ab'ekyokusatu abo bayinza okukola ku mawulire amatono nga bagoberera ebiragiro byabwe eby'eby'ekyama n'amateeka agakwatibwako.
PrivacyPolicyPage.thirdPartyText3: Tukuwa amagezi okwekenneenya ebiragiro by'eby'ekyama eby'obuweereza bw'ab'ekyokusatu bw'okozesa okuyita ku mukutu gwaffe.
PrivacyPolicyPage.securityText1: Tuteeka mu nkola ebipimo ebisaanidde okuyamba okukuuma amawulire agakolebwako okuyita ku mukutu gwaffe. Kyokka, tewali mukutu wadde buweereza bwa yintaneeti obuyinza okukakasa obukuumi obujjuvu.
PrivacyPolicyPage.securityText2: Tukubiriza abakozesa okwewala okuwaayo amawulire g'obwannamunigina oba ag'ekyama agatetaagisa.
PrivacyPolicyPage.childrenText1: InstaView Stories tegenderera kukuŋŋaanya mu bugenderevu amawulire g'obwannamunigina okuva ku baana.
PrivacyPolicyPage.childrenText2: Bw'oba olowooza nti omwana yawaayo amawulire g'obwannamunigina okuyita ku mukutu gwaffe, tukusaba otukwatagane tulyoke twekenneenye embeera ne tukola ekisaanidde nga kyetaagisa.

PrivacyPolicyPage.externalLinksText2: Tukuwa amagezi okwekenneenya etteeka ly'eby'ekyama ery'omukutu gwonna ogw'ab'ekyokusatu gw'okyalira.
PrivacyPolicyPage.choicesText1: Okusinziira ku kifo mw'obeera n'amateeka agakwatibwako, oyinza okuba n'eddembe erimu erikwata ku mawulire go ag'obwannamunigina.
PrivacyPolicyPage.choicesText2: Bw'oba olina ekibuuzo oba okusaba okukwatagana n'eby'ekyama, oyinza okutukwatagana ng'okozesa amawulire agali wammanga.
PrivacyPolicyPage.changesText1: Tuyinza okukyusa Etteeka lino ery'Eby'Ekyama oluusi ku luusi okulaga enkyukakyuka mu mukutu gwaffe, obuweereza, wadde ebyetaago ebikwatibwako.
PrivacyPolicyPage.changesText2: Enkyukakyuka zonna zijja kuteekebwa ku lupapula luno n'olunaku olupya olw'okukyusibwaako oluvannyuma.
PrivacyPolicyPage.contactIntro: Bw'oba olina ebibuuzo ku Tteeka lino ery'Eby'Ekyama oba engeri InstaView Stories gy'ekozesaamu amawulire, tukwatagane:
